description: Create 4 performance utility modules under Frontend/src/utils/ for code splitting, image optimization, cache configuration, and weak internet detection. These utilities enable lazy loading, responsive images, cache strategies, and graceful offline handling for a scalable, high-performance marketplace.
steps: Create Frontend/src/utils/code-splitting.ts: export lazyPage<T>() function wrapping React.lazy for page bundle splitting

Create Frontend/src/utils/image-optimization.ts: export IMAGE_PRESETS object (thumbnail, card, detail, hero), getResponsiveImage(baseUrl, preset) function, getSrcSet(baseUrl, preset) function for CDN URL generation
Create Frontend/src/utils/cache-strategy.ts: export CACHE_CONFIG constant with keys (listings, categories, profile, search) mapping to {staleTime, gcTime} in milliseconds; define CacheKey type

Create Frontend/src/utils/weak-internet.ts: export NetworkState type ('connected'|'slow'|'offline'), useNetworkState() hook reading navigator.onLine + connection.effectiveType, useDataSaver() hook reading localStorage + navigator.connection.saveData, getRetryDelay(attempt) exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, max 30s)
Ensure all files are TypeScript strict mode, zero 'any', proper types exported
acceptance_criteria: All 4 utility files created and export expected functions/types
lazyPage() properly wraps React.lazy for page components
IMAGE_PRESETS contains all 4 presets with w, h, q properties
getResponsiveImage() and getSrcSet() generate proper image URLs
CACHE_CONFIG has all 4 keys with staleTime and gcTime in milliseconds
useNetworkState() and useDataSaver() are proper React hooks
getRetryDelay() returns exponential backoff values (1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, capped at 30000)
npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
verification: Import each utility: verify imports work (import { lazyPage } from '@/utils/code-splitting', etc.)
npm run build — should include utilities in bundle
